title: Seawater eDNA extraction for Sterivex - rocky intertidal habitats
author: Mary McElroy

steps.title: Process SX TUBE and SX CAPSULE samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the buffer and filter components for extraction.

substeps.instruction: SX TUBE: Transfer Longmire’s buffer from the Sterivex filter capsule into a 2mL sterile LoBind tube using a 5 mL Luer-Lock syringe (avoid excessive pressure).
SX TUBE: Spin at 6,000 * g (8,000 rpm) for 30-45 min in a 24 * 2mL micro-centrifuge and discard the liquid.
SX CAPSULE: Remove and discard the inlet and outlet caps of the capsules.
SX CAPSULE: Dry filters by placing them vertically (inlet end facing down) on clean lab tissue paper in a hood rack.

steps.title: Prepare lysis working solution
steps.instruction: Create the lysis working solution for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 μL ATL buffer and 100 μL proteinase K per sample.

steps.title: Apply lysis working solution
steps.instruction: Add the working solution to the processed samples.

substeps.instruction: SX TUBE: Add 200 μL working solution per sample to dissolve the dried pellet, close the tube, seal with parafilm, and vortex for 5 s.

SX CAPSULE: Close the outlet end with a sterile end cap. Use a 1,000 μL pipet with extended-length sterile filter tips to add 800 μL Lysis working solution between the filter and the capsule walls. Close the open end with a sterile inlet cap and handshake vigorously for 5 s.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes and capsules on a rotator.

substeps.instruction: Secure all tubes and capsules on the rotator.
Incubate while rotating at 56°C for up to 24 hours; record the start time.

steps.title: Prepare for elution
steps.instruction: Remove samples from incubation and prepare the elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from the incubator and record the time.
Set the incubator to 70°C and heat Buffer AE at 70°C until the elution step.

steps.title: Transfer samples to LoBind tubes
steps.instruction: Collect the processed samples into 5 mL LoBind tubes.

substeps.instruction: SX TUBE: Transfer 200 μL to a labeled 5 mL LoBind tube.
SX CAPSULE: Use a Luer Lock syringe to remove ALL liquid from the inlet end of the capsule and transfer to a 5 mL LoBind tube.
Note the approximate volume in each 5 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add Buffer AL and ethanol to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add Buffer AL and ice-cold 99% ethanol in a 1:1:1 ratio (Sample:Buffer:Ethanol).
Add AL to all tubes first, then add cold ethanol.
Vortex vigorously for 5 s.

steps.title: Filter through DNeasy spin column
steps.instruction: Pass the mixture through a DNeasy spin column.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the mixture (max 650 μL at a time) into a labeled DNeasy spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Spin in micro-centrifuge at 6,000 * g (8,000 rpm for 24 * 1.5-2 mL rotor) for 1 min.
Discard flow-through, keep the collection tube, and repeat until all sample is filtered.

steps.title: Wash DNeasy column
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Place the DNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube.
Add 500 μl Buffer AW1 and centrifuge for 1 min at 6,000 * g (8,000 rpm).
Discard flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Dry DNeasy column
steps.instruction: Perform the second wash and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place the DNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube.
Add 500 μl Buffer AW2 and centrifuge for 3 min at 20,000 * g (14,000 rpm).
Discard flow-through and re-use the collection tube.
Centrifuge for an additional 1 min at 17,000 * g (13,000 rpm).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the membrane into a LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new labeled 2 mL DNA LoBind tube with caps removed.
Add 100 μl of 70°C Buffer AE to the membrane.
Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 10 min.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 6,000 * g (8,000 rpm).
Repeat the addition of buffer, incubation, and centrifugation.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Finalize and store the eluted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Discard the spin column and keep the LoBind tube containing the DNA eluted in 200 μl AE.
Store at -20°C.
